title: Move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.13.0 pair: regenerate schemas, bump CI pins, regenerate managed blocks
summary: Operator ruling (opum-agent OPAG-1258, 2026-10-08): move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.13.0 pair as one PR. Run lore schema export under 0.13.0 to regenerate .lore/schemas/; bump every live CI pin to @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 and the Quest version CLAUDE.md declares; regenerate the managed blocks. Schemas and pins land together (LCLI-690). Gate: lore check green under the 0.13.0 pin in CI on the PR head, then promote dev to main.
description: The workstation global lore and quest are 0.13.0 and stay there. The repo still pins lore 0.12.0 in ci.yml (LORE_VERSION) and declares Quest CLI 0.12.0 in the managed Quest block, and .lore/schemas/ was last exported under lore 0.12.0. The CI Tracker job derives the Quest version from the managed block, so regenerating the block is the only place the Quest pin lives. Regenerating the block and exporting schemas are the routine managed-block/schema carve-outs: generated bytes only. Out of scope: the docs frontmatter by: lore/0.11.0 provenance stamps, which are history rather than live pins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The .lore/schemas/ directory is regenerated by lore schema export under lore 0.13.0, and lore check --strict is green with no schema-drift finding
ci.yml LORE_VERSION reads 0.13.0 and no live CI pin of @opum-ai/lore or LORE_VERSION still reads 0.12.0
The CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.13.0 (regenerated by quest agents --update-instructions --target claude), and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0
The PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity, with the Docs job installing lore 0.13.0 and the Tracker job installing Quest 0.13.0 read from the log version line

plan: Run lore schema export under 0.13.0, regenerating .lore/schemas/
Bump ci.yml LORE_VERSION 0.12.0 -> 0.13.0; sweep by field name for any other live pin of @opum-ai/lore, @opum-ai/quest or LORE_VERSION
Regenerate the managed Quest block: quest agents --update-instructions --target claude; assert every changed byte is inside the managed markers
Regenerate the lore:agents block where it applies: lore agents
Local gates: lore check --strict, lore validate --strict, quest agents --check, lore agents --check, node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs, bun run check, git diff --check
Commit, push, open the PR into dev; wait on the head SHA check-runs
Complete WCLI-71 on the branch; wait for the merge-gate run on the closure commit
Squash merge, delete the local branch
Promote dev to main at orchestrator direction; read origin/main back by ref; report to team-lead

finalSummary: Move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.13.0 pair, one PR (opum-ai/ward-cli#147). .lore/schemas/ regenerated by lore schema export under 0.13.0 (10 profileDigest bumps plus the new standard.schema.json type); ci.yml LORE_VERSION 0.12.0 -> 0.13.0 (the CI Tracker job derives the Quest version from the managed block, so the block is the only Quest pin); managed Quest block regenerated 0.12.0 -> 0.13.0 by quest agents --update-instructions --target claude, one generated line inside the markers with the outside-marker residue asserted byte-identical; lore agents reported its block unchanged.
